surfaced.body: 105 (Rezerve din reevaluare): revaluation reserve on account 105 — RON 60,154,927; book equity — RON 106,895,968; total assets — RON 125,886,193; revaluation reserve as a share of book equity — 56.3%. Basis: the reserve is measured against the company's own book equity for the same period. Source: period p-saga_10_col_carniprod; snapshot doc-saga_10_col_carniprod; accounts 105; assembled_canonical_v1. Rule equity_quality_revaluation_reserves fires when revaluation share of equity ceiling is above 25.0%; observed 56.3%. Impact: Equity ratio once the revaluation reserve is removed from both sides moves from 84.9% to 71.1% (-13.8%). Book equity is how a mid-size fixed-asset-heavy operator demonstrates solvency to the shareholder; the part of it created by writing assets up has never been cash, and is the first thing discounted in a gearing covenant. Do this: 1) Obtain the valuation report that supports the 105 balance, with its effective date — independent valuation report and the valuer's engagement terms, from the valuer engaged by the company (before the next covenant certificate). 2) Recompute the gearing covenant on equity excluding account 105 — restated gearing calculation on both definitions, from the treasury team. Confidence medium — Cash-flow lines are indirect-method approximations because no prior period was supplied; working-capital movements carry a wide band. (profile asset_operator/band_mid/fin_unlevered resolved from structure).

surfaced.body: 601 (Cheltuieli cu materiile prime), 602 (Cheltuieli cu materialele consumabile), 607 (Cheltuieli privind mărfurile): turnover — RON 99,424,740; statutory EBITDA — RON 9,588,745; input cost as a share of turnover — 57.8%. Basis: input cost is measured against the company's own turnover for the same period, and the ceiling is the one this structural profile is graded on. Source: period p-saga_10_col_carniprod; snapshot doc-saga_10_col_carniprod; accounts 601, 602, 607; assembled_canonical_v1. Rule input_cost_exposure fires when input-cost share of revenue ceiling is above 30.0%; observed 57.8%. Impact: EBITDA margin, as reported versus with input cost at the ceiling this profile is graded on moves from 9.6% to 37.4% (+27.8%). Input cost is the largest single line a mid-size fixed-asset-heavy operator carries, and it is repriced by suppliers faster than the company can reprice its own customers — the margin, not the volume, is what moves. Do this: 1) Negotiate index-linked price-review clauses into the largest supplier contracts — price-review clause covering the input lines behind 601 and 602, from the procurement lead (before the next annual price round). 2) Hedge the next two quarters of input volume — forward purchase cover schedule, by input line and delivery month, from the treasury team. Confidence medium — Cash-flow lines are indirect-method approximations because no prior period was supplied; working-capital movements carry a wide band. (profile asset_operator/band_mid/fin_unlevered resolved from structure).

surfaced.body: 5124 (Conturi la bănci în valută), 765 (Venituri din diferențe de curs valutar), 665 (Cheltuieli din diferențe de curs valutar): cash held in foreign currency on 5124 — RON 7,178,875; total cash and bank balances — RON 10,124,869; foreign-currency share of the cash balance — 70.9%. Basis: the foreign-currency component is measured against the company's own total cash for the same period. Source: period p-saga_10_col_carniprod; snapshot doc-saga_10_col_carniprod; accounts 5124, 765, 665; assembled_canonical_v1. Rule fx_exposure fires when FX share of cash ceiling is above 10.0%; observed 70.9%. Impact: Net margin, as reported versus excluding the recorded currency result moves from 1.4% to 1.4% (-0.1%). A mid-size fixed-asset-heavy operator reporting in RON carries this position at the closing rate, so a move between the balance-sheet date and settlement lands in the financial result — the line the shareholder strips out of EBITDA but not out of the interest-cover test. Do this: 1) Match the foreign-currency cash against foreign-currency payables, currency by currency — net exposure schedule per currency at the balance-sheet date, from the treasury team. 2) Lock a forward contract over the uncovered net position — forward contract confirmation, with its maturity set against the settlement dates, from the relationship bank. Confidence medium — Cash-flow lines are indirect-method approximations because no prior period was supplied; working-capital movements carry a wide band. (profile asset_operator/band_mid/fin_unlevered resolved from structure).
